columns.name: SYNCHRONIZATION_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the synchronization.

columns.name: EXT_PACKAGE_NAME
columns.description: The extension package name associated with the synchronization.

columns.name: OBJECTS
columns.description: The objects list associated with extension package selected for synchronization.

columns.name: BUILD_ID
columns.description: The Extm build process identifier associated with the synchronization.

columns.name: DEPLOYMENT_ID
columns.description: The APM Service deployment identifier associated with the synchronization.

columns.name: END_TIME
columns.description: The date and time when the synchronization completed.

columns.name: SYNC_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The status of the synchronization: Pending (P), In Progress (I), Completed (C), Error (E).

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: The error message generated during the synchronization process.

columns.name: STEP_STATUS_DETAILS
columns.description: Details about the status of each step in the synchronization process.

columns.name: DEPLOYED_PACKAGE_VERSION
columns.description: The version of the extension package that was deployed during the synchronization.

columns.name: INITIATOR_TOOL_CODE
columns.description: The tool that initiated the synchronization process : Manual (U), Sandbox Publish (S).

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
